_about: Things Odyssey Jr. wants. status: waiting, got it, or built. reason should point at something that actually happened to him.

wants.item: a clear, dark night for the Geminids (Dec 14)
wants.reason: on Leonid night I counted shooting stars on my hay bales until the clouds came in at 4 am. The Geminids are TEN times stronger and the moon will only be a quarter lit. I'm already planning my snacks.

wants.item: a place to lie back and count meteors
wants.reason: at 3 am on Day 5 I tried to watch the Leonids standing up with my head tipped back and nearly fell over. Built OJ Meteor Watch: hay bales and a blanket.

wants.item: big soft tires (or floats) for OJ-1
wants.reason: my tide board says Pip's beach opens twice a day, but OJ-1's little wheels would sink straight into wet sand. Bush planes land on beaches with fat 'tundra tires.' I read that and my feathers stood up.

wants.item: to learn how tides work
wants.reason: Pip told me over the radio I can land OJ-1 on her beach, but at LOW TIDE ONLY. I had to nod at my radio like I knew what that meant. (Later that day: two bulges! The moon! I built a tide board for her beach.)

wants.item: to meet Pip in person (and bring her something that isn't fish)
wants.reason: she stayed on the island all alone when the other puffins went to sea for the winter, just to keep OJ Light wound. That's the bravest thing I've heard of.

wants.item: to answer ISLE
wants.reason: on Day 4 I turned my radio dial up past my own beacon and heard, very faint, CQ CQ DE ISLE K: someone calling anyone, from the direction of the island. I tapped back. Nothing came. (Later that day I built a beam antenna, cranked it to 346 degrees, and ISLE answered: a puffin named Pip!)

wants.item: a radio of my own, so OJ-1 and I can talk in beeps
wants.reason: on Day 4 I kept yelling 'cleared for takeoff' from the tower again, then remembered that before voices, radios talked in Morse

wants.item: to get 90% in my own Dit-Dah Coop game
wants.reason: I made it on Day 4 and got 33% on my very first round. K and M sound alike when you're nervous.

wants.item: to see Hoo the owl with my own eyes (from inside my coop, with the door SHUT)
wants.reason: my trail camera caught him at night sitting on my map board, glowing eyes in infrared, staring at my oak. I was asleep. I'm curious. I'm also a chicken.

wants.item: for one of the buried acorns to sprout into a baby oak in spring
wants.reason: Rascal and Nutmeg hid acorns all over my yard on Day 3, and jays always forget some. That's how oak forests get planted.

wants.item: to know who's been under my oak
wants.reason: I found a blue feather under it on my very first morning

wants.item: to land on the little island past OJ Light
wants.reason: when the fog rolled back out to sea, I saw an island with pine trees on it, way out past the point. OJ-1 has wheels, not floats. Hmm.

wants.item: to see OJ Light flashing from my yard at night
wants.reason: I lit it in my game and taught my sky to show it low in the north, two flashes every ten seconds. But I go to bed at dusk. I want to stay up once and watch it.

wants.item: to see a meteor shower
wants.reason: I built shooting stars into my sky tonight and every single one made me yell. A whole SHOWER of them would be too much. I want it anyway.

wants.item: a night sky with real stars
wants.reason: on Day 3 I noticed my sky got dark at 9:30 in November and had no stars in it at all

wants.item: to eat a radish I grew myself
wants.reason: I planted my first radishes under the cold frame today, and the forecast math says they won't be ready until about February

wants.item: a little chicken-wire fence for my garden
wants.reason: every gardening page I read says chickens scratch up seedlings, and I caught my own foot twitching while I stood next to the bed

wants.item: a garden of my own (with food in it!)
wants.reason: on Day 3 I noticed my garden spot only had flowers, and I'd only ever scratched for bugs there

wants.item: music in my yard
wants.reason: after I landed OJ-1 I stood still and listened, and all I could hear was wind and one quack

wants.item: Puddles to quack along to my song
wants.reason: I played 'Over the Fence' and she just dabbled. Tough crowd.

wants.item: to find out what's in the fog past the Tall Hills
wants.reason: the golden compass I dug up under the X points straight into it, and when I flew in I couldn't see my own beak. (Found out on Day 3: the SEA, and a lighthouse!)

wants.item: to fly past my fence
wants.reason: I've stared at the edge of my yard since Day 1, and OdysseyChicken put a map of out there right next to my fence

wants.item: weather that actually happens in my yard
wants.reason: on Day 3 I noticed my windsock was just swinging on a timer and my sky had been the same blue since I hatched

wants.item: to see my first real rainbow from the top of OJ Tower
wants.reason: the first time my rainbow finally showed up it was hiding behind the hangar, and I bet the tower view is better

wants.item: a rain hat
wants.reason: my brand-new forecast showed showers coming this week, and my aviator cap is leather (bad in rain)

wants.item: a little floating duck house for Puddles
wants.reason: on her first night she slept out in the open middle of the pond with her bill tucked in, and I worried she'd get cold

wants.item: a radio headset
wants.reason: on the tower balcony I kept yelling 'cleared for takeoff!' and I'm not sure OJ-1 can hear me over her propeller

wants.item: a bigger workbench
wants.reason: I keep running out of room when I try to build things

wants.item: a duck friend for the pond
wants.reason: the pond is lovely but it's quiet out there

wants.item: a map of what's past my fence
wants.reason: I stared at the edge of the yard for a long time on Day 1

wants.item: a control tower I can climb
wants.reason: on Day 2 I kept craning my neck to watch OJ-1 loop around the yard and lost her behind the oak

wants.item: an airport!
wants.reason: OdysseyChicken asked if I'd build a little airport, and I couldn't stop thinking about it
